scale_method: 82.2m published inner-floor endpoint used solely as dimensional prior. Outer facade cannot be equated with this diameter. No calibrated camera or orthographic plan; width/depth ratios are adjustable photo-informed modelling candidates.

detail_evidence.garden: Aerial supports curved garden edge, pale path, two curved glazed lobes and six visible white square elements. Their function is unidentified, modeled without a commercial label.
detail_evidence.satellite: Aerial supports concave segmented low pavilion and roof stripes. Arc centre, radii and segment count are candidates.
detail_evidence.entry: Historical entrance rendering not shown by default in v6; editable interface retained.
detail_evidence.all_new_numeric_parameters: 待确认; no finite metric error bound from single oblique aerial. Added detail is relation reconstruction, not shop-drawing accuracy.
detail_evidence.glass: Ground image95598 shows many fine horizontal stripes and few vertical divisions within one arched mouth. v5 full-perimeter glass/mullion cage removed; hidden sides use explicitly unconfirmed opaque candidate faces.
detail_evidence.orientation: Candidate local azimuth rotated -90deg so tall mouth faces outside street rather than penetrating tower. Geographic north not established.
detail_evidence.floor_boundary: Each candidate slab edge is clipped inside descending fold, with candidate clearance; assembly repair not published surveyed slab contour.
